reviews.frank_statement: FRANK must preserve causal/semantic/authority distinctions, replay identity, atomic semantic publication and ordered lifecycle/role semantics across representation changes.
reviews.counterhypothesis: A schema-blind deterministic serializer is enough; collection type and runtime authority-instance placement do not need to affect canonical identity.
reviews.falsifier: Production compiler/replay evidence shows order changes and per-run authority embedding cannot change executable/replay meaning or artifact reproducibility.
independent_checks: RFC 8949 and MLIR used as external design triangulation only
reviews.reason: Independent executable evidence supports type-directed canonical identity and runtime-authority separation, but production parser/typed-IR/Ubuntu replay remains required.
